title: 鹿特丹港貝圖威貨運線~Betuweroute freight railway
focus: 港區貨運列車的阻力制動與容量協同~Coordinating freight resistance braking and port capacity
summary: 鹿特丹港貝圖威貨運線以「港區貨運列車的阻力制動與容量協同」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。專用貨運線把港區裝卸、列車編組與幹線運行連成同一條物流鏈，列車較長與較重會同時改變加速、制動及站場占用，單看最高速度不足以推估吞吐量。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops coordinating freight resistance braking and port capacity through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. A dedicated freight line links port handling, train assembly and mainline movement; longer heavier trains change acceleration, braking and yard occupation together, so maximum speed alone does not determine throughput. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把鹿特丹港貝圖威貨運線放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。專用貨運線把港區裝卸、列車編組與幹線運行連成同一條物流鏈，列車較長與較重會同時改變加速、制動及站場占用，單看最高速度不足以推估吞吐量。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Betuweroute freight railway in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. A dedicated freight line links port handling, train assembly and mainline movement; longer heavier trains change acceleration, braking and yard occupation together, so maximum speed alone does not determine throughput. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n=5 trains/h, q=1800 t/train；y=n*q=9000 t/h。只把 n 增加百分之十，y=9900 t/h。模型邊界：固定每列有效載重與發車率，不含尖峰到達或空車需求；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=2000000 kg, g=9.81 m/s2, s=0.01 1；y=m*g*s/1000=196.2 kN。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=215.82 kN。模型邊界：全列車處於同一小坡度，只計重力沿軌分量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: n=5 trains/h, q=1800 t/train; y=n*q=9000 t/h. Increasing only n with a ten-percent increase gives y=9900 t/h. Boundary: Fixed useful payload and departure rate, excluding peak arrivals and empty returns; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=2000000 kg, g=9.81 m/s2, s=0.01 1; y=m*g*s/1000=196.2 kN. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=215.82 kN. Boundary: The whole consist occupies one small gradient; only longitudinal gravity is included; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 列車單向運能~Directional train throughput
units.title: 列車單向運能~Directional train throughput
units.mechanism: 運能是班次與有效載重的乘積，空車回送及車站衝突仍會消耗路徑。本模型把 n 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 9900 t/h。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定每列有效載重與發車率，不含尖峰到達或空車需求。使用滿載率與實際發車間距作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把額定載重當實際載重會高估貨物流量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Throughput multiplies departures by useful payload, while empty returns and conflicting moves still consume paths. In this model, n is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 9900 t/h. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Fixed useful payload and departure rate, excluding peak arrivals and empty returns. Use load factor and actual departure intervals as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Using rated payload as actual payload overstates cargo flow; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n=5 trains/h, q=1800 t/train；y=n*q=9000 t/h。只把 n 增加百分之十，y=9900 t/h。模型邊界：固定每列有效載重與發車率，不含尖峰到達或空車需求；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: n=5 trains/h, q=1800 t/train; y=n*q=9000 t/h. Increasing only n with a ten-percent increase gives y=9900 t/h. Boundary: Fixed useful payload and departure rate, excluding peak arrivals and empty returns; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以滿載率與實際發車間距區分模型與觀察，先用站場發車時間戳與貨物秤重帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「列車單向運能」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use load factor and actual departure intervals to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using yard departure timestamps and cargo weighing records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Directional train throughput. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 把額定載重當實際載重會高估貨物流量。這個失效與「列車單向運能」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查滿載率與實際發車間距，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Using rated payload as actual payload overstates cargo flow. This failure and a measurement bias in Directional train throughput can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check load factor and actual departure intervals rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把額定載重當實際載重會高估貨物流量~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using rated payload as actual payload overstates cargo flow.
units.practice: 重算「列車單向運能」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出固定每列有效載重與發車率，不含尖峰到達或空車需求如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把額定載重當實際載重會高估貨物流量造成偏離的合成觀察，以滿載率與實際發車間距說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Directional train throughput, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Fixed useful payload and departure rate, excluding peak arrivals and empty returns. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Using rated payload as actual payload overstates cargo flow. Explain which evidence in load factor and actual departure intervals distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 坡道牽引分力~Gradient traction force
units.title: 坡道牽引分力~Gradient traction force
units.mechanism: 小坡度下重力沿軌分量與列車質量成正比，坡度正負號決定牽引或制動需求。本模型把 m 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 215.82 kN。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。全列車處於同一小坡度，只計重力沿軌分量。使用坡度定位與車列總重作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略尾車仍在另一坡段會誤算整列車受力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~At small gradients the longitudinal gravitational force scales with train mass, and its sign distinguishes traction from braking demand. In this model, m is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 215.82 kN. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. The whole consist occupies one small gradient; only longitudinal gravity is included. Use gradient location and total consist mass as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring wagons still on another gradient miscalculates total force; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=2000000 kg, g=9.81 m/s2, s=0.01 1；y=m*g*s/1000=196.2 kN。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=215.82 kN。模型邊界：全列車處於同一小坡度，只計重力沿軌分量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=2000000 kg, g=9.81 m/s2, s=0.01 1; y=m*g*s/1000=196.2 kN. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=215.82 kN. Boundary: The whole consist occupies one small gradient; only longitudinal gravity is included; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以坡度定位與車列總重區分模型與觀察，先用合成坡度圖與逐車質量清單建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「坡道牽引分力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use gradient location and total consist mass to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic gradient profile and wagon mass list, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Gradient traction force. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 忽略尾車仍在另一坡段會誤算整列車受力。這個失效與「坡道牽引分力」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查坡度定位與車列總重，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Ignoring wagons still on another gradient miscalculates total force. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.anchor: 速度與牽引功率~Speed and tractive power
units.title: 速度與牽引功率~Speed and tractive power
units.mechanism: 同一牽引力在較高速度需要更高機械功率，功率限制與黏著限制是不同邊界。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.6 MW。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。輪周力與速度同時取得，只計機械功率。使用輪周功率與速度的同步紀錄作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把低速最大牽引力延用到高速會超出功率邊界，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~The same tractive force needs more mechanical power at higher speed; power and adhesion limits are different boundaries. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 6.6 MW. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Wheel force and speed are simultaneous; only mechanical power is counted. Use synchronous wheel-power and speed records as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Extending maximum low-speed force to high speed exceeds the power boundary; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=300000 N, v=20 m/s；y=F*v/1e6=6 MW。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=6.6 MW。模型邊界：輪周力與速度同時取得，只計機械功率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=300000 N, v=20 m/s; y=F*v/1e6=6 MW. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.6 MW. Boundary: Wheel force and speed are simultaneous; only mechanical power is counted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以輪周功率與速度的同步紀錄區分模型與觀察，先用模擬輪周力與同步速度訊號建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「速度與牽引功率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use synchronous wheel-power and speed records to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using simulated wheel force and synchronous speed signal, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

units.anchor: 貨列制動距離~Freight braking distance
units.title: 貨列制動距離~Freight braking distance
units.mechanism: 制動建立前列車仍前進，反應距離與常減速度制動距離必須相加。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 866.25 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。延遲時等速，其後固定減速度，不含坡度與黏著變化。使用制動建立延遲與速度衰減曲線作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只計算穩態制動段會低估長車列停車距離，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~The train continues moving while braking builds up, so delay distance must be added to constant-deceleration stopping distance. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 866.25 m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Constant speed during delay followed by constant deceleration, without gradient or adhesion variation. Use brake build-up delay and speed-decay trace as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Counting only steady braking underestimates a long consist stopping distance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=25 m/s, a=0.5 m/s2, tau=4 s；y=v*tau+v**2/(2*a)=725 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=866.25 m。模型邊界：延遲時等速，其後固定減速度，不含坡度與黏著變化；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=25 m/s, a=0.5 m/s2, tau=4 s; y=v*tau+v**2/(2*a)=725 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=866.25 m. Boundary: Constant speed during delay followed by constant deceleration, without gradient or adhesion variation; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以制動建立延遲與速度衰減曲線區分模型與觀察，先用合成制動命令、速度及減速度時間序列建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「貨列制動距離」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use brake build-up delay and speed-decay trace to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic brake-command, speed and deceleration traces, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. units.title: 列車噪音能量比較~Train noise-energy comparison
units.mechanism: 同聲能事件數倍增只改變能量總量，不代表單一列車更吵。本模型把 n 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 3.35792 dB。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。各事件聲暴露相同且能量相加，不含不同列車差異。使用相同距離的事件聲暴露與事件數作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；將分貝直接相加會嚴重誤判累積噪音，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Multiplying equal-energy events increases total energy without making an individual train louder. In this model, n is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 3.35792 dB. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Equal sound exposure per event with additive energy, excluding differences among trains. Use event sound exposure and count at equal distance as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Adding decibels directly misrepresents accumulated sound energy; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n=12 events, ref=6 events；y=10*log(n/ref)/log(10)=3.0103 dB。只把 n 增加一個整數單位，y=3.35792 dB。模型邊界：各事件聲暴露相同且能量相加，不含不同列車差異；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: n=12 events, ref=6 events; y=10*log(n/ref)/log(10)=3.0103 dB. Increasing only n with an increase of one whole unit gives y=3.35792 dB. Boundary: Equal sound exposure per event with additive energy, excluding differences among trains; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以相同距離的事件聲暴露與事件數區分模型與觀察，先用固定位置聲暴露計與事件計數建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「列車噪音能量比較」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use event sound exposure and count at equal distance to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using fixed-position sound-exposure meter and event counter, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Train noise-energy comparison. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 將分貝直接相加會嚴重誤判累積噪音。這個失效與「列車噪音能量比較」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查相同距離的事件聲暴露與事件數，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Adding decibels directly misrepresents accumulated sound energy. This failure and a measurement bias in Train noise-energy comparison can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check event sound exposure and count at equal distance rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：將分貝直接相加會嚴重誤判累積噪音~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Adding decibels directly misrepresents accumulated sound energy.
units.practice: 重算「列車噪音能量比較」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出各事件聲暴露相同且能量相加，不含不同列車差異如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由將分貝直接相加會嚴重誤判累積噪音造成偏離的合成觀察，以相同距離的事件聲暴露與事件數說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Train noise-energy comparison, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Equal sound exposure per event with additive energy, excluding differences among trains. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Adding decibels directly misrepresents accumulated sound energy. Explain which evidence in event sound exposure and count at equal distance distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 隧道換氣量級~Tunnel ventilation scale
units.title: 隧道換氣量級~Tunnel ventilation scale
units.mechanism: 平均流速乘有效斷面給出體積流量，列車活塞作用與局部回流需另列。本模型把 A 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 85.8 m3/s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。有效斷面上的均勻平均風速，不含暫態活塞效應。使用多點風速與有效斷面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只用中心風速代表全斷面會高估或低估通風，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Mean velocity times effective area gives volume flow, while piston action and local recirculation need separate treatment. In this model, A is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 85.8 m3/s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform mean velocity across effective area, excluding transient piston effects. Use multi-point air velocity and effective area as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Using only centreline velocity misrepresents total ventilation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：A=65 m2, u=1.2 m/s；y=A*u=78 m3/s。只把 A 增加百分之十，y=85.8 m3/s。模型邊界：有效斷面上的均勻平均風速，不含暫態活塞效應；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: A=65 m2, u=1.2 m/s; y=A*u=78 m3/s. Increasing only A with a ten-percent increase gives y=85.8 m3/s. Boundary: Uniform mean velocity across effective area, excluding transient piston effects; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以多點風速與有效斷面區分模型與觀察，先用多點風速計與斷面量測建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「隧道換氣量級」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use multi-point air velocity and effective area to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using multi-point anemometers and section measurements, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Tunnel ventilation scale. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 只用中心風速代表全斷面會高估或低估通風。這個失效與「隧道換氣量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查多點風速與有效斷面，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Using only centreline velocity misrepresents total ventilation. This failure and a measurement bias in Tunnel ventilation scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check multi-point air velocity and effective area rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只用中心風速代表全斷面會高估或低估通風~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using only centreline velocity misrepresents total ventilation.
units.practice: 重算「隧道換氣量級」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出有效斷面上的均勻平均風速，不含暫態活塞效應如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由只用中心風速代表全斷面會高估或低估通風造成偏離的合成觀察，以多點風速與有效斷面說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Tunnel ventilation scale, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform mean velocity across effective area, excluding transient piston effects. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Using only centreline velocity misrepresents total ventilation. Explain which evidence in multi-point air velocity and effective area distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

timeline.event: 貝圖威路線的高速公路平行區段正式啟用。~The Betuweroute A15 section officially entered service.
港區貨運線完成歐洲列車控制與二十五千伏系統投入使用。~The Havenspoorlijn brought ERTMS and 25 kV systems into service.
荷蘭議會結束貝圖威計畫的大型專案治理資格。~The Dutch parliament ended the Betuweroute major-project governance status.
